edges.reason: msg.sender is stored into deployer in the constructor, granting privileged role.
startSale is gated by onlyDeployer which compares msg.sender against deployer.
mintWithPunkOrGlyph requires msg.sender to own the referenced punk or glyph.
mint attributes the minted token and refund to msg.sender.
msg.sender is both the balance key and the recipient of the low-level ETH call in withdraw.
block.timestamp is written into saleStartTime in startSale.
getPrice depends on block.timestamp to compute elapsed sale time and price.
randomIndex mixes block.timestamp into its pseudo-random seed.
tradeValid compares block.timestamp against offer.expiry, making validity time dependent.
communityGrant require gates the mintWithPunkOrGlyph grant phase.
marketPaused require gates mintWithPunkOrGlyph.
creatorNftMints is checked and incremented to prevent duplicate punk/glyph minting.
publicSale require gates the public mint function.
marketPaused require gates the public mint function.
numSales is compared to SALE_LIMIT and incremented on each mint.
SALE_LIMIT bounds the number of public sale mints.
beneficiary receives the computed sale price during mint.
reentrancyLock guards mint against reentrant calls.
reentrancyLock guards mintWithPunkOrGlyph.
reentrancyLock guards acceptTrade despite external interactions.
reentrancyLock guards withdraw around the low-level call.
mint performs native ETH transfers to msg.sender (refund) and beneficiary.
withdraw forwards ETH with a low-level call to an arbitrary caller address.
verify recovers the signer with ecrecover from assembled signature bytes.
_safeTransferFrom uses isContract (extcodesize) to decide whether to invoke the receiver hook.
_safeTransferFrom calls onERC721Received on the receiving contract, enabling reentrant callbacks.
The callback return value retval is checked against MAGIC_ON_ERC721_RECEIVED.
tokenURI calls toString to render the token id.
randomIndex produces the id assigned by _mint.
_mint registers ownership by calling _addNFToken.
_mint increments numTokens after checking TOKEN_LIMIT.
_transfer clears pending approval via _clearApproval.
_transfer adds the token to the recipient's enumerable list.
_transfer removes the token from the sender's enumerable list.
acceptTrade validates the offer via tradeValid before settling.
acceptTrade moves maker and taker tokens through _transfer.
acceptTrade credits and debits ethBalance for both parties.
acceptTrade records the offer hash in cancelledOffers to prevent replay.
withdraw decrements the caller's ethBalance (checked-effects-interactions ordering).
deposit credits ethBalance[msg.sender] with msg.value.
deposit consumes msg.value when crediting the caller balance.
tradeValid hashes the offer with the Ethereum signed message prefix via hashToVerify.
tradeValid verifies the maker signature through verify/ecrecover.
hashToSign builds an Offer and delegates hashing to hashOffer.
tradeValid rejects offers present in cancelledOffers.
cancelOffer marks the offer hash cancelled.
safeTransferFrom with data delegates to _safeTransferFrom.
safeTransferFrom without data delegates to _safeTransferFrom.
mint reads msg.value to check and refund the computed sale price.
mintWithPunkOrGlyph queries the punks contract for punk ownership.
mintWithPunkOrGlyph queries the glyphs contract for glyph ownership.
supportsInterface reads the supportedInterfaces mapping.
transferFrom reads idToOwner to validate and locate the owner.
mintsRemaining subtracts numSales from SALE_LIMIT.
totalSupply returns numTokens.
mintWithPunkOrGlyph calls _mint for the sender.
mint calls getPrice to determine the payable amount.
mint calls _mint for the sender.
devMint loops calling _mint for the recipient.
price argument is assigned to the price state variable.
saleDuration argument is assigned to the saleDuration state variable.
_createVia selects the punk/glyph whose ownership is required and records the mint.
pause flag is written to marketPaused.
quantity bounds the devMint minting loop.
recipient is the address receiving devMint tokens.
amount is validated against and deducted from ethBalance[msg.sender].
maker identifies the counterparty whose balance and tokens are debited.
taker restricts who may accept the offer.
signature is passed to verify for maker authentication.
The constructed Offer struct is hashed and validated in tradeValid.
index selects the shuffled slot to return as the token id.
salePrice is compared with msg.value and used for refunds/beneficiary transfer.
totalSize bounds the modulo used for index selection.
Computed punkId is passed to punkIndexToAddress for ownership verification.
Computed glyphId is passed to IERC721.ownerOf for ownership verification.
elapsed derived from block.timestamp and saleStartTime drives the price decay.
tokenOwner is compared against msg.sender in the canTransfer authorization check.
The offer hash is checked against cancelledOffers.
